claims.text: The company's About page gives the number of universities on its network as 20+.
The company's About page says SPN puts every graduate scheme, internship, placement, apprenticeship and event in one place, for students at any university or college.
claims.quote: SPN puts every graduate scheme, internship, placement, apprenticeship and event in one place, for students at any university or college

claims.text: The About page names Leo Tashev and Fraser Lloyd as the company's co-founders.
claims.quote: Leo Tashev Co-founder Fraser Lloyd Co-founder

claims.text: The site's footer gives the company as Student Property Network Ltd, registered in England & Wales.
claims.quote: Student Property Network Ltd · Registered in England & Wales

claims.text: In the interview the founders say that on average one applicant in 140 is accepted for a graduate role in the UK (their figure; PrompTugal has not checked it).
claims.quote: one applicant in 140 is accepted for a graduate role

claims.text: In the interview the founders say they work with 27 universities and their real estate societies (their figure; the company's site says 20+).
claims.quote: they work with 27 universities and their real estate societies

claims.text: One founder explains in the interview that they collect jobs with their own scrapers written in Python into a database, and a large language model decides whether each job is accepted onto the list.
claims.quote: they collect every job they can find with their own scrapers, written in Python, into a database, and a large language model decides whether each job is accepted onto the list
